issues.t: Clunk from the rear when stopping
issues.sym: A single clunk or thump from under the back of the vehicle as you come to a stop or pull away, often around 75,000 miles.
issues.why: This is the most reported GX 470 complaint. It comes from the driveshaft slip joint and rear suspension, which bind as the grease dries out; Lexus issued a service fix for it.
issues.next: It is usually not dangerous. Ask a shop or dealer to grease or service the driveshaft slip joint per the Lexus bulletin before replacing major parts.

issues.t: Rear air suspension sagging or failing
issues.sym: The rear sits low, especially after parking overnight, the ride gets harsh, the compressor runs a lot, or a suspension warning light comes on.
issues.why: The rear air springs and their lines dry out and leak with age, and the compressor wears out trying to keep up.
issues.next: Have the air springs and lines checked for leaks. Some owners convert to regular coil springs instead of buying new air parts.

issues.sym: A ticking or tapping noise from the engine, loudest on a cold start, and sometimes an exhaust smell.
issues.why: The cast exhaust manifolds on the 4.7L V8 crack or lose studs from years of heating and cooling, letting exhaust leak.
issues.next: Have it inspected; exhaust leaks near the engine can let fumes reach the cabin. Broken studs make the repair take longer.

issues.sym: Check engine light, sometimes with the vehicle going into a weak limp mode, typically around 110,000 miles.
issues.why: The secondary air injection pump and valves, which help clean up exhaust on cold starts, fail when moisture gets into them.
issues.next: Have the codes read. It will not leave you stranded right away, but it must be fixed to pass emissions testing.

issues.sym: Power steering fluid drips under the front, a whining pump, or the steering feeling heavier.
issues.why: The seals in the steering rack wear and start leaking fluid.
issues.next: Check the fluid level often and get the leak diagnosed. Do not let the reservoir run dry, or the pump can be damaged.

issues.sym: Cracks spreading across the top of the dashboard, often starting near the vents or windshield.
issues.why: The dashboard top material shrinks and cracks with heat and sun exposure. Owners say Lexus has done little about it.
issues.next: A dash cover hides it. Replacing the dash pad is a big job.

issues.sym: The sunroof moves unevenly, stops partway, makes a grinding noise, or won't close fully.
issues.why: Dirt in the tracks and misalignment make the sunroof bind.
issues.next: Have the tracks cleaned, lubricated and realigned. Close it only when it is moving freely to avoid breaking the cables.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy without a crash (recall)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light, or the side curtain airbags going off without a crash.
issues.why: The airbag control module was improperly programmed and could fire the side curtain airbags in rough off-road conditions.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V-065. A Lexus dealer reprograms or replaces the module free.

issues.t: Stability control may let SUV slide in sharp turns (recall)
issues.sym: No warning; in a sharp, fast turn the rear can slide out, raising rollover risk.
issues.why: Consumer Reports found the stability control let the 2010 GX 460 slide too far before stepping in. Lexus recalled it and reprogrammed the system.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 10V-159. The software update is free at a Lexus dealer.

issues.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash. In a crash the inflator can burst and throw metal pieces.
issues.why: The passenger airbag uses a Takata inflator whose propellant breaks down over time in heat and humidity. Several recalls cover different years and regions.
issues.next: Check your VIN right away for open airbag recalls (such as 16V-340, 17V-006, 18V-024, 19V-005 and 19V-741). The replacement is free.

issues.sym: Oil leaking from the front of the engine, oil on the skid plate, or a burning-oil smell.
issues.why: The seal between the timing chain cover and the 4.6L V8 lets oil seep out. Owners report it around 65,000 miles.
issues.next: Watch your oil level. Resealing the timing cover is labor-heavy, so it is often done together with the water pump.

issues.sym: Pink crusty residue around the pulleys or on the skid plate, a sweet smell, or the coolant level dropping.
issues.why: The water pump seal weeps coolant, a common issue on the 4.6L V8.
issues.next: Have it checked when you first see pink residue, before the coolant runs low and the engine overheats.

issues.t: Secondary air pump or valve failure
issues.sym: Check engine light with codes like P2440 or P2442, and the vehicle may go into limp mode with sluggish acceleration.
issues.why: The secondary air pump and switching valves clog or fail. Toyota/Lexus extended coverage on these parts for many 2010-2013 vehicles.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Lexus dealer whether the extended coverage applies to your VIN before paying.

issues.sym: Loss of power or stalling when pulling away from a stop, rough idle and a check engine light.
issues.why: RepairPal lists throttle body failure as a common GX 460 problem.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Cleaning sometimes helps, but a failed electronic throttle body must be replaced.

issues.sym: Oil found in the plug wells during service, a burning-oil smell, or misfires.
issues.why: Spark plug tube seals and valve cover gaskets leak oil into the plug wells.
issues.next: Have the valve cover gaskets and tube seals replaced if oil is found, before it damages the ignition coils.

issues.sym: The steering wheel shakes or the brake pedal pulses when braking from speed.
issues.why: Owners report the front rotors warp early, especially with hard braking on this heavy SUV.
issues.next: Have the rotors measured. Replacing them with the pads usually cures the shake.

issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, check engine or master warning light, stalling while driving, or a no-start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can stop working.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-012. A dealer replaces the pump free.

issues.sym: Rough running, warning lights, stalling while driving, or a no-start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can fail on these years.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-682. The replacement pump is free.

issues.sym: Knocking, rough running, no-start, or a sudden loss of power while driving.
issues.why: Machining debris left in the 3.4L twin-turbo V6 during manufacturing can damage the main bearings and cause the engine to fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-767. Stop driving and call a dealer if you hear knocking. Lexus has replaced engines for free under the earlier version of this recall.

issues.t: Instrument cluster may not show warning lights (recall)
issues.sym: A warning light or indicator that should appear does not come on.
issues.why: The gauge cluster software may fail to display some required warnings.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-341. A dealer updates the software free.

issues.sym: No mechanical symptom; the label shows incorrect figures for how much weight you can add.
issues.why: The load capacity label has inaccurate values, which could lead an owner to overload the SUV.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-179 and get the corrected label. Do not exceed the weight limit in the owner's manual.
